### Don Templin Elected to Jackson’s Board of Directors


10/14/2026


LANSING, Mich.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Jackson Financial Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.jackson.com%2F&esheet=54621049&newsitemid=20261014339852&lan=en-US&anchor=Jackson+Financial+Inc.&index=1&md5=222f93faf567623d0ca84faff8fd00b6) i (NYSE: JXN) (Jackson®) announced today that its Board of Directors has elected Donald C. (“Don”) Templin as a new independent director. He was also appointed as a member of the Board’s Audit and Compensation committees.


“I am pleased to welcome Don to Jackson’s Board of Directors,” said Steve Kandarian, independent chair of the Jackson board. “His experience as a financial leader in the insurance and energy industries, combined with his extensive audit expertise, gives him a deep understanding of complex, highly regulated businesses and long-term capital allocation. We are confident Don will bring a valuable perspective to our Board.”


“I am honored to join Jackson’s Board of Directors at such an exciting time for the company,” Templin said. “Jackson has established a strong position in the retirement industry through its financial discipline, commitment to its policyholders and focus on long-term value creation. I look forward to working with my fellow directors to provide thoughtful oversight and support the company’s continued success.”


Templin is the former Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Voya Financial. Prior to Voya, he held senior leadership roles at Marathon Petroleum Corporation, including Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. His earlier career also included a 26-year tenure as a certified public accountant at PricewaterhouseCoopers LLC, culminating in his role as Managing Partner of the Audit Practice in Georgia, Alabama and Tennessee. In the past 13 years, he also has served as an independent director on three public company boards, of which he was an audit committee member for two of those boards. Templin holds a Bachelor of Arts in Accounting from Grove City College.
